title: Tomato yellow leaf curl virus - Cambodia

Header: Tomato yellow leaf curl virus - Cambodia

Prevention: Practice crop rotation by planting crops that are not susceptible to
Protect seedling beds with a white nylon net (40 mesh), to protect seedlings from whiteflies.
Pull out virus-diseased seedlings and remove.
Plant barrier crops like maize around tomato.
These crops should be sown a month before transplanting tomato.
Mulch tomato fields with plastic sheets or sawdust or straw.
Thin plants to reduce plant density and increase air movement.
Plough-under all plant debris after harvest or burn them if possible.
Monitoring: Scouting should begin when the plants are young until harvest time.
Direct Control: Spray garlic bulb extract to control whitefly.
Restrictions: The chemical control is for control of whiteflies, to delay virus attack.
